source_evidence: Day330~21:06 exact player 'Okok, let them go and I don’t have to cave your skulls in' issues a credible explicit conditional threat from the existing camp, seeking immediate release, not yet an attack, pursuit, advance or resource spend. V Intimidation+7 (CHA3 proficiency3 Luckstone1); Fenar independently supports the threat by deliberately stepping into the visible firelight in a threatening ready posture, meaningful Help; predeclared advantage, DC18 release both captives/DC13 hesitation. Actual visible Python secrets receipt batch95803ecfcec70add2a35e17109e440e2 d20 faces6,17 take17+7=24 succeeds DC18. No superiority/Knack/Past Life or other finite resource spent. The leader looks between V and Fenar, judges ransom not worth risking his men and orders 'Cut them loose. We're leaving.' One guard cuts the two captives' wrist bindings; both captives are released alive without new injury, no silver recovered or ransom paid. The six armed men begin withdrawing west along the road away from the camp without attacking; still visibly within approximately100ft at the next decision, not disarmed/arrested, no guarantee they won't commit future crimes. The two released adults independently make their way cautiously toward the camp via the roadside opening; the woman supports her fatigued companion. Mara independently offers water and a place by the fire, Cirren waits to check them with consent. No medical spell, expenditure, new named identity, detailed story, exact home location, escort commitment or report yet. No V movement, speech beyond supplied words, initiative, weapon attack or automatic pursuit. V chooses whether to let abductors depart, intervene further or attend to captives. D330 encounter counted once; no night rest or recovery yet.
